caption: A motorboat crosses a glassy lake at low speed, and its reflection travels with it, broken only by the wake.

sa.check: A motorboat crosses a glassy lake at low speed.
The reflection is broken only by the wake.
The reflection is attached at the waterline.

pc.expect: The reflection travels with the boat and distorts only in the wake behind.
pc.fail: It stays still while the boat moves; or it is broken ahead of the boat; or it lags.

pc.expect: The reflection is inverted and attached at the waterline.
pc.fail: It is upright; or detached; or a different boat.

pc.expect: The water is liquid: the wake spreads behind and the surface ahead is flat.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or the wake runs ahead; or the water leaps.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves with the boat stopped; or drifts.

pc.expect: One boat and one reflection; the reflection stays on the water.
pc.fail: A second boat appears; or the reflection rises off the water; or the boat vanishes; or the reflection becomes solid.

pc.expect: The boat and the shore stay the same.
pc.fail: The boat changes colour; or the shore rearranges; or the sky changes abruptly.
